title: Perfect acceptance for correct products
statement: Let $n,r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let a seed map each $r$-bit string to a vector in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$. If $C'=AB$, then the seeded verification acceptance probability is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Matrices A, B, and C' over the two-element field
Seed map from r-bit strings to vectors in F₂ⁿ
